resources.string: App Lock uses this service only to see which app is opened, so it can show the lock screen over the apps you chose. It does not read screen content and sends nothing off the phone.
This PIN or pattern is used whenever face and fingerprint do not work. Do not forget it.
Draw a new pattern (at least 4 dots)
They did not match. Start again.
App Lock is not active yet
Turn on “App Lock” in Accessibility settings so it can notice when a locked app opens. On Android 13+ you may first need: Settings → Apps → App Lock → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
Look at the phone to unlock with face
Too many wrong attempts. Wait %1$d s.
Methods are tried from top to bottom. Use the arrows to change the order and the switch to turn a method off.
Always last, cannot be turned off
Ready (uses the face registered in phone settings)
This phone does not let apps use its face unlock
Register face / fingerprint in phone settings

Note: the face step uses the phone\'s own face unlock through the Android system window. Android decides what that window accepts; if no face is registered, the phone may ask for a fingerprint there instead. To stop others from turning App Lock off, also lock the Settings app.
